title: Knockout Silky Irish Oat Pudding
description: A sour and silky lacto-vegetarian friendly Irish dish featuring vanilla, perfect for a sick day, made by poaching oats in milk and flavoring with vanilla and a touch of sugar.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the milk, sugar, and salt, and heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved and the milk is just simmering.
Add the rolled oats to the saucepan and cook, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes, or until the oats have absorbed most of the milk and the mixture has a thick and creamy consistency.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the vanilla extract and butter until the butter has melted and the mixture is smooth.
Let the mixture cool slightly, then cover the saucepan with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until chilled.
Just before serving, if using the egg, whisk it lightly in a small bowl, then stir it into the chilled oat mixture until well combined.
Spoon the oat pudding into individual serving cups or a large serving dish, and serve chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of sugar or a dollop of whipped cream if desired.
